search_text: published ZDI-09-013 ZDI-CAN-423 Mozilla Firefox XUL Linked Clones Double Free Vulnerability 2009-03-05 CVE-2009-0775 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-0775 ['Mozilla Firefox'] ['3.0.x'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Mozilla Firefox. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists during the browsers garbage collection process. When multiple DOM elements are cloned and linked to one another and the browser is reloaded, a memory corruption occurs resulting in a double free. This can be leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user. Mozilla Firefox has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
